statements.note: Impact claim with no concrete settling check. The project is a private application (package.json private: true), not a library. Changes include moving src/data/ar-io-peer-manager.ts to src/peers/, moving getPeers from arweaveClient to arweavePeerManager internally, and replacing db with txOffsetSource in the chunk offset handler; config.ts only adds new env vars (+38 -0). No removed env var or public HTTP route was found, but behaviour of /chunk/:offset changes (new chain fallback, on by default), and whether that counts as breaking cannot be settled from the diff.
